tips.text: Do the bonus objective on every stage; the all-bonus extra stage 5 roll is the best Isoplast and blueprint roll.
Run the bounties in Fortuna instead of Cetus; the drop tables match but Vallis objectives stay closer together.
Leave disarming companions and abilities at home on Cetus; a disarmed Narmer captain turns invincible and stalls the bounty.
Farm Isoplast in rotations A and B and push bounties hard once rotation C is up for the blueprint.
Bring Volt, Nova or Wisp for drone-escort stages, the slowest stage type.
Keep spare Isoplast instead of trading it for standing; Caliban, Verdilac, Nepheri and Venato draw from the same pool.
Farm Caliban, Verdilac, Nepheri and Venato in the same bounties; they all need Narmer Isoplast.
Run Narmer bounties in a premade squad.
Check the Arsenal or the wiki's hidden-Mastery list to confirm Korumm is mastered; it is missing from Profile Progress.
Narmer bounties are widely disliked; the blueprint is easy and the Isoplast is the grind, so farm it in small daily sessions.
Expect about 5 full rotation C bounties for the blueprint and 5 to 6 for the Isoplast; bad luck runs past 15.
